title: Nurse speaks for first time in Virginia

tellings.quote: there was also, I think, a nurse there who had worked under you. And for the first time, she started to speak about this being.

plain: A nurse at a hospital in Virginia, who had worked under a surgeon named Amar, spoke for the first time about a non-human "being" said to have been treated there. Michels raises it himself while interviewing the surgeon, saying "for the first time, she started to speak about this being." If true, it would back up the surgeon's account that his hospital operated on an alien.
